description: This file defines the CalendarService class implementing CalendarServicing protocol, providing methods to fetch calendar events and add new events using EventKit framework. It handles permission checks, event retrieval within a date range, and event creation with validation.

classes.name: CalendarService
classes.description: A class providing calendar event retrieval and addition functionalities, conforming to CalendarServicing protocol.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches events within a specified date range, formats them, and returns as payload.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates and saves a new calendar event with specified parameters, ensuring permissions and validity.
